title: SkyBot ML Health
description: PPO, world model, curiosity gate, replay sampler, timing and numeric-health counters from learning.jsonl. A missing producer logs null -> no row -> a gap, never a zero.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT wall_time AS time, key AS metric, value FROM learning_kv WHERE (key IN ('ppo.policy_loss', 'ppo.value_loss')) AND wall_time BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom() AND $__unixEpochTo() ORDER BY wall_time
SELECT wall_time AS time, key AS metric, value FROM learning_kv WHERE (key IN ('ppo.approx_kl', 'ppo.clip_frac')) AND wall_time BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom() AND $__unixEpochTo() ORDER BY wall_time

SELECT wall_time AS time, key AS metric, value FROM learning_kv WHERE (key IN ('ppo.entropy', 'ppo.explained_variance')) AND wall_time BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom() AND $__unixEpochTo() ORDER BY wall_time
SELECT wall_time AS time, key AS metric, value FROM learning_kv WHERE (key LIKE 'ppo.grad_norm%') AND wall_time BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom() AND $__unixEpochTo() ORDER BY wall_time

SELECT wall_time AS time, key AS metric, value FROM learning_kv WHERE (key IN ('ppo.adv_mean', 'ppo.adv_std', 'ppo.ret_mean')) AND wall_time BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom() AND $__unixEpochTo() ORDER BY wall_time

SELECT wall_time AS time, key AS metric, value FROM learning_kv WHERE (key IN ('ppo.lr', 'ppo.n_samples', 'ppo.epochs', 'ppo.minibatches')) AND wall_time BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom() AND $__unixEpochTo() ORDER BY wall_time
SELECT wall_time AS time, key AS metric, value FROM learning_kv WHERE (key LIKE 'wm.loss_%') AND wall_time BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom() AND $__unixEpochTo() ORDER BY wall_time
SELECT wall_time AS time, key AS metric, value FROM learning_kv WHERE (key IN ('wm.kl_raw', 'wm.grad_norm')) AND wall_time BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom() AND $__unixEpochTo() ORDER BY wall_time

SELECT wall_time AS time, key AS metric, value FROM learning_kv WHERE (key IN ('wm.prior_entropy', 'wm.posterior_entropy')) AND wall_time BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom() AND $__unixEpochTo() ORDER BY wall_time
SELECT wall_time AS time, key AS metric, value FROM learning_kv WHERE (key IN ('wm.steps', 'wm.replay_ratio')) AND wall_time BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom() AND $__unixEpochTo() ORDER BY wall_time

SELECT wall_time AS time, key AS metric, value FROM learning_kv WHERE (key IN ('curiosity.evaluated', 'curiosity.passed_sig', 'curiosity.passed_abs', 'curiosity.paid', 'curiosity.collapsed_visits')) AND wall_time BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom() AND $__unixEpochTo() ORDER BY wall_time

SELECT wall_time AS time, key AS metric, value FROM learning_kv WHERE (key IN ('curiosity.mean_paid', 'curiosity.buckets')) AND wall_time BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom() AND $__unixEpochTo() ORDER BY wall_time
SELECT wall_time AS time, key AS metric, value FROM learning_kv WHERE (key LIKE 'replay.%') AND wall_time BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom() AND $__unixEpochTo() ORDER BY wall_time
SELECT wall_time AS time, key AS metric, value FROM learning_kv WHERE (key = 'timing.steps_per_s') AND wall_time BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom() AND $__unixEpochTo() ORDER BY wall_time

SELECT wall_time AS time, replace(key, 'timing.', '') AS metric, value FROM learning_kv WHERE (key LIKE 'timing.%' AND key <> 'timing.steps_per_s') AND wall_time BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom() AND $__unixEpochTo() ORDER BY wall_time
